title: Customer API: picking the response version a client asked for
name: Customer API versions

questions.prompt: After we shipped API version 1.10 of the customer endpoint, mobile clients that send X-Api-Version: 1.10 (or anything newer, like 2.0) still get the 1.9 response shape, and clients on 1.20 are served 1.2. Clients that send no header or an old version look fine. Fix Versions so the tests pass.
